schedule: After genuine original local commit but BEFORE old queue admission, real signed peer CAS advances the remote image with remote-only wallet or changed xpub at the retained walletID. Then the old receipt reads the actual advanced peer snapshot, refuses old authority and sends zero own mutations.
preservedAssertions: Original seven operations × both actual remote-only/key-conflict triggers.
No own mutation request, every original pending/completed flag, exact peer wallet xpub intact.
strongerObservables: Actual status200 committed peer CAS and fully valid positive ACK/base must be witnessed.
Exactly one actual successful old-operation snapshot read and zero own mutations/enrollment/repair.
Complete committed local image/account and independent recovery records survive, including rejected Delete consent.
Whole actual signed remote image matches the original baseline plus only the exact peer change.
Replay of the old original receipt sends zero further HTTP and cannot rebase to peer authority.
fixtureTransition: Genuine signed peer CAS replaces the legacy server.seed whole-image helper; all peer recovery content and pre-admission schedule are preserved.
